mapper.select: SELECT r.id FROM recommendation r INNER JOIN couple c ON c.id = r.couple_id WHERE r.couple_id = #{coupleId} AND (c.inviter_id = #{memberId} OR c.invitee_id = #{memberId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation (couple_id) VALUES (#{coupleId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
INSERT INTO recommendation_product ( recommendation_slot_id, product_id, rank_no, is_selected ) VALUES ( #{slotId}, #{product.productId}, #{product.rank}, #{product.selected} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recommendation_product rp INNER JOIN recommendation_slot rs ON rs.id = rp.recommendation_slot_id WHERE rs.recommendation_id = #{recommendationId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recommendation_product rp INNER JOIN recommendation_slot rs ON rs.id = rp.recommendation_slot_id WHERE rs.recommendation_id = #{recommendationId} AND rp.is_selected = 1
